issues.problem: pt-no-koto rule/explain/contrast said こと is required with verbs of saying incl. 言う, contradicting pt-quote (a reported statement takes と; 結婚することを言いました is listed as a mistake).
issues.action: Narrowed to verbs of telling or deciding (話す, 伝える, 約束する, 決める) and added a pointer that plain 言う reports with と.

issues.problem: pt-no-koto tip listed 言う as a こと trigger, same contradiction.
issues.action: Replaced with です, できる, ある, 伝える.

issues.problem: pt-hikaku explain said a positive after ほど is wrong without noting the separate degree use (泣くほど痛い), which a learner would then treat as an error.
issues.action: Added one sentence marking degree ほど as a different use.

issues.problem: pt-quote mistake note assumed the teacher's gender ('said he would set homework').
issues.action: Reworded neutrally: 'the teacher announced that homework would be set'.
